notes: Double-tap-to-zoom is gone EVERYWHERE, properly this time — the old fix only covered the page body, and zoom rules don't inherit, so newer surfaces could still zoom; now every element blocks it (pinch-zoom and scrolling untouched). Drum recording is now actually usable: hitting Record on the Pads page automatically brings in a METRONOME CLICK so you have a beat to play against (it steps back out when you stop, unless you pin it), and a new Clear button wipes the pattern to start the take over. The click is a global setting — toggle it on the Pads page or in Settings > Sound and it plays through Studio loop AND Arrange song playback, never in WAV exports.
